translations/en.ts.meals_refusal_unauthenticated: 'The sign-in was not accepted. Please sign in again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_refusal_unknown: 'We could not read this. The list is not shown — that does not mean it is empty.'
translations/en.ts.meals_unlisted_company_one: 'One order is booked to a company account that is not in the agreement list above.'
translations/en.ts.meals_unlisted_company: '{count} company accounts that are not in the agreement list above have orders at this venue.'
translations/en.ts.meals_footnote_no_totals: 'The amounts come from the server, one per order. We do not add them up: a total on credit sales belongs on the monthly statement, which the server computes and freezes.'
translations/en.ts.meals_setup_intro: 'Where a company is set up: the company itself, its agreement with this venue, its meal programme and policy, and its invitations.'
translations/en.ts.meals_setup_no_ordering: 'Nothing here lets an employee order. Ordering on a company account sits behind its own flag, and no Okam app offers a company account as a way to pay. Standing a programme up here does not make lunch buyable.'
translations/en.ts.meals_setup_pick_company: 'Pick a company above to see its agreement, programmes and invitations.'
translations/en.ts.meals_picker_intro: 'The companies with an agreement at this venue, plus any you have just created.'
translations/en.ts.meals_picker_none: 'No company has an agreement at this venue yet.'
translations/en.ts.meals_picker_by_id_intro: 'The module has no route that lists company accounts. The list above is this venue\'s agreements, so a company you created earlier and have not yet signed an agreement for is reachable only by its identifier.'
translations/en.ts.meals_picker_unconfirmed: '{count} company account(s) here are not in this venue\'s agreement list — created just now, or opened by identifier. They leave this list when you reload: sign the agreement first, or keep the identifier.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_company_id_invalid: 'That is not a valid identifier. It looks like 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.'
translations/en.ts.meals_concierge_only: 'This is an Okam concierge operation. This account does not hold that authority, so the form is not shown.'
translations/en.ts.meals_company_create_intro: 'The company is created together with its first company administrator. There is no other way in: invitations require an administrator to already exist.'
translations/en.ts.meals_company_identity_fixed: 'Organisation number, country and status cannot be changed here. The route has no field for them — archiving is an operation of its own.'
translations/en.ts.meals_first_admin_help: 'Authority over a company comes only from an active company-admin membership — never from the Okam role that creates it. Name somebody else here and you will be able to neither read nor edit the account afterwards.'
translations/en.ts.meals_no_revision: 'The server sent no revision token, so we will send no change. Without it a save can silently overwrite somebody else\'s.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_country_required: 'The country must be a two-letter ISO code.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_admin_required: 'A first company administrator must be named.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_no_revision: 'We were missing the revision token, so we sent nothing. Reload the page.'
translations/en.ts.meals_corridor_intro: 'The agreement binds the company, the venue and the currency together. Everything else in the module hangs off it.'
translations/en.ts.meals_corridor_exists: 'This company already has an active agreement here. A second one for the same company, venue and currency is refused — the first must be ended, and that cannot be done from this screen.'
translations/en.ts.meals_corridor_no_currency: 'We could not read this venue\'s market, so we do not know which currency the agreement should be in. Signing is withheld — an agreement in the wrong currency cannot be edited, only ended.'
translations/en.ts.meals_corridor_currency_note: 'The currency comes from this venue\'s market and cannot be typed here. It is part of the agreement\'s identity, and every policy version under it must carry exactly this currency.'
translations/en.ts.meals_corridor_immutable_note: 'The seller details are frozen as they stand here. No route edits an agreement — one is superseded by being ended and signed again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_currency_required: 'We have no currency to sign the agreement in.'
translations/en.ts.meals_program_create_intro: 'A programme hangs off the agreement, not off the venue: its venue, currency and seller all follow from the agreement.'
translations/en.ts.meals_program_needs_corridor: 'A programme needs an active agreement between this company and this venue. Sign the agreement first.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_no_active_corridor: 'There is no active agreement to attach the programme to.'
translations/en.ts.meals_policy_immutable_note: 'A policy cannot be changed afterwards. Every change is a new version, and the previous one stands.'
translations/en.ts.meals_policy_no_read_note: 'We can tell you which version is current, but not what it says: the module has no route that reads a policy version back. Only the version number travels with the programme.'
translations/en.ts.meals_policy_currency_note: 'The currency follows from the agreement and cannot be chosen. The server stores the agreement\'s currency whatever is sent.'
translations/en.ts.meals_policy_zone_note: 'The time zone is the one the weekdays and window are evaluated in. The suggestion is the zone this venue uses today; only the server can decide whether a zone exists.'
translations/en.ts.meals_policy_effective_note: 'The moment is read in your own time zone and sent as an absolute instant.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_allowance_not_a_number: 'The allowance must be a plain number.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_allowance_too_many_decimals: 'The allowance can have at most two decimals.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_allowance_too_large: 'The allowance is too large to be represented exactly.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_weekdays_required: 'At least one weekday must be chosen.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_window_invalid: 'The window must be clock times in HH:MM form.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_window_order: 'The end time must be after the start time.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_effective_from_required: 'The moment the policy takes effect is required.'
translations/en.ts.meals_mig17_title: 'Without an employee reference, this invitation produces a membership that cannot be labelled later.'
translations/en.ts.meals_mig17_body: 'The reference can only be captured here, at the invitation. A membership claimed without one can never acquire it: the invitation is spent, and the lines of a finalized monthly statement are locked. The person then appears as a bare identifier on every line of that company\'s bill, for good.'
translations/en.ts.meals_mig17_ack: 'I understand this invitation produces a membership that will appear as a bare identifier on every future monthly statement, and that it cannot be corrected later.'
translations/en.ts.meals_token_not_sent_body: 'Okam has no way to deliver this token — no email, no SMS. It exists here and nowhere else. For the invitation to reach anybody you have to pass the token on yourself, through a channel you trust.'
translations/en.ts.meals_token_bearer_note: 'The token works once, and whoever claims it must be signed in as the contact you named. A forwarded token is refused.'
translations/en.ts.meals_token_claim_screen: 'Whoever you give the code to redeems it themselves at {link}. They paste the code in there and sign in. Okam sends them nothing, so the address has to travel with the code.'
translations/en.ts.meals_token_copy_failed: 'We could not copy automatically. Select the text in the field and copy it yourself.'
translations/en.ts.meals_token_once_note: 'The token is not shown again. No route can produce it a second time — if it is lost, revoke the invitation and issue a new one.'
translations/en.ts.meals_invite_intro: 'Give an email or a phone number. The contact is not just a label: whoever claims the invitation must be signed in as that person.'
translations/en.ts.meals_field_employee_ref_hint: 'The company\'s own reference for this person — payroll number, cost centre or initials. It lands on every line of the monthly statement and in the export the accountant opens. Never a fødselsnummer; the server refuses one. This is the only moment it can be supplied.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_contact_required: 'An email or a phone number is required.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_expires_range: 'The number of days must be between 1 and 90.'
translations/en.ts.meals_err_ack_required: 'Fill in the employee reference, or confirm you have read what leaving it empty entails.'
translations/en.ts.meals_invitations_none: 'No invitation has been issued for this company.'
translations/en.ts.meals_members_none: 'Nobody has claimed a membership in this company yet.'
translations/en.ts.meals_members_display_note: 'This column is exactly what lands on every line of the company\'s monthly statement: its own employee reference where one was supplied, otherwise the membership id. The module knows no names. Rows marked "no employee reference" cannot be corrected — the invitation is spent, and finalized statements are locked.'
translations/en.ts.meals_refusal_company_dark: 'Company Meals is not switched on for this installation, or there is nothing here to show. The module answers the same way to both.'
translations/en.ts.meals_refusal_company_forbidden: 'This account has no active company-admin membership for this company. That is the only place the authority comes from — never from a store or Okam role.'
translations/en.ts.meals_refusal_concierge_forbidden: 'This requires Okam concierge authority. This account does not hold it.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_stale: 'Somebody else changed this in the meantime. Nothing was saved. Reload the page and try again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_stale_policy: 'The programme has a newer policy version than we expected. Nothing was saved. Reload and check which version is current before publishing.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_idempotency_mismatch: 'The server recognised the attempt but the contents differed. Nothing was saved. Reload the page and try again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_in_progress: 'The same attempt is already being processed. Wait a moment and try again — do not do it twice.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_invitation_not_claimable: 'This invitation can no longer be revoked — it has already been claimed or revoked. Nothing was changed.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_currency_mismatch: 'The currency does not match the agreement\'s. Nothing was saved.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_validation: 'The server refused the details as they stand. Nothing was saved.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_rejected: 'The server refused the request. Nothing was saved.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_network: 'We could not reach the server, so we do not know whether anything was saved. Reload the page before trying again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_write_unknown: 'Something went wrong. We do not know whether anything was saved — reload the page before trying again.'
translations/en.ts.growth_page_intro: 'From what your guests consented to, to a send you can stand behind. Every step below is checked against the consent record — nothing here can grant permission on a guest\'s behalf.'
translations/en.ts.growth_standing_intro: 'What your guests have agreed to, as counts. These are not recipients.'
translations/en.ts.growth_standing_unknown: 'We could not read the consent record. This does not mean there are no consents — it means we do not know, and nothing may be sent until we do.'
translations/en.ts.growth_standing_scope_note: 'Suppression reasons are shown as recorded. How far each one reaches is not shown here, because that is not yet settled.'
translations/en.ts.growth_standing_no_grant_note: 'There is no way to add a subscriber or grant consent from this screen. Consent comes from the guest, through double opt-in, or it does not exist.'
translations/en.ts.growth_audience_intro: 'A fixed, unchangeable list of who may receive this send, worked out from the consent record at the moment you compute it.'
translations/en.ts.growth_audience_none: 'No audience has been computed yet, so there is no recipient count to show. We will not estimate one.'
translations/en.ts.growth_audience_immutable_note: 'This list does not change after it is computed. Recomputing over an unchanged consent record returns the same list, not a new one.'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_intro: 'Each save creates a new, unchangeable version. Editing an approved newsletter withdraws its approval — a review can never green-light content it did not see.'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_needs_audience: 'Compute an audience first. A newsletter is bound to the audience it will be sent to, so it cannot be written before one exists.'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_body_hidden_title: 'The content of version {version} is not shown'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_body_hidden: 'The API gives us the subject and a fingerprint of the content, but not the content itself. The saved content therefore cannot be edited from here — only replaced. If you save, whatever is in the boxes below becomes a new, unchangeable version, and the old content is no longer what gets sent. To see what this version actually contains, send yourself a test further down.'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_content_hidden_placeholder: 'Empty because the saved content cannot be retrieved. Write the whole content again.'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_replace_ack: 'I want to replace the content of version {version} with what is in the boxes above.'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_replace: 'Replace the content and save a new version'
translations/en.ts.growth_draft_replaced: 'Saved as a new version. The content was replaced with what was in the boxes.'
translations/en.ts.growth_test_intro: 'Sends the current version to the email address on your own account, through the provider\'s test route. It reaches no guest and touches no consent record.'
translations/en.ts.growth_test_result: 'Test submitted. The provider answered: {status}. That is a submission status, not a delivery confirmation.'
translations/en.ts.growth_test_module_off: 'The newsletter module is switched off for this store (growth.module), so the test route does not answer. A platform operator has to switch it on.'
translations/en.ts.growth_approval_intro: 'Approval pins this exact version, its content and its audience. If any of the three changes, the approval falls away and must be given again.'
translations/en.ts.growth_approval_unseen_body: 'This screen cannot show the content of the saved version. Send yourself a test first, so you approve something you have actually seen.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_intro: 'A send happens only when every condition below is met. Anything unresolved stops it, including anything we could not check.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_ready_caveat: 'Everything we can check from here is in order. One thing we cannot see: the deployment-wide Growth:Enabled switch is not reported by any endpoint, so a send can still be refused by it.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_mail_unknown: 'We could not read this store\'s provider setup.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_mail_none: 'No provider account is registered for this store.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_mail_binding_note: 'These are the provider accounts this store has been given. Which mail engine the server is actually running is not reported by any endpoint and cannot be read from here.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_dispatched_note: 'This version has already been submitted. Sending again would not send a second time — there is one send per approved version.'
translations/en.ts.growth_gate_dispatched_toast: 'The send ran. The provider accepted {accepted} of {eligible} recipients. Delivery is only confirmed once the provider reports back — see “What happened” below.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_consent_unreadable: 'We could not read the consent record, so we cannot confirm anyone may be mailed.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_no_audience: 'No audience has been computed, so there is no confirmed list of who may receive this.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_empty_audience: 'Nobody in the audience may currently be mailed.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_not_approved: 'This version has not been approved by a person.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_approval_superseded: 'The approval was given for an earlier version and no longer covers this one.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_no_unsubscribe: 'Recipients would have no working way to unsubscribe. Sending marketing mail without one is not lawful, so this send is refused.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_module_off: 'The newsletter module is switched off for this store (growth.module), so the send route does not answer at all. A platform operator has to switch it on.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_dispatch_off: 'The dispatch kill switch is off for this store (growth.dispatch). Nothing is created and nothing is sent until it is switched back on.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_provider_paused: 'A provider account for this store is paused. While it is, nothing is sent.'
translations/en.ts.growth_block_platform_unreadable: 'We could not read this store\'s newsletter and dispatch switches, so we do not know whether a send would reach anything at all. Reload the page.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_truth_note: 'Accepted and delivered are counted separately. The provider taking a message for sending is not the same as it arriving.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_state_pending: 'The run has been created, but no send has been picked up yet. The figures below are not final.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_state_in_progress: 'The run is still sending. The figures below are not final.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_state_completed: 'Every send reached a final outcome. The figures below are final — apart from opens, which keep arriving.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_state_reconciliation: 'At least one send is parked for review, so the run cannot yet be closed truthfully.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_read_unknown: 'Not read from the server in this session.'
translations/en.ts.growth_run_refresh_note: 'These figures do not update themselves. Delivery, failures and opens are recorded when the provider reports back, which is after the send ran.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_forbidden: 'You do not have access to this store\'s newsletters.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_no_live_approval: 'This newsletter has not been approved, so it cannot be sent.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_approval_stale: 'The approval no longer matches this version. Approve it again.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_stale_version: 'Somebody else saved a newer version. Reload before saving.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_unattributed: 'We could not tell who you are, so this was not recorded.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_newsletter_not_editable: 'This newsletter has started sending and can no longer be edited.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_newsletter_not_approvable: 'This newsletter has started sending and can no longer be approved.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_test_address_not_own: 'A test send can only go to the email address on your own account, and that address has to be confirmed. If your account has no email address on file, or the one it has is not confirmed, you cannot send a test until you confirm one. You do that under «My email address».'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_dispatch_disabled: 'The dispatch kill switch is off for this store (growth.dispatch). Nothing was created and nothing was sent. A platform operator has to switch it on.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_provider_paused: 'This store\'s provider account is paused. Nothing was created and nothing was sent. Unpause it before trying again.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_unsubscribe_unconfigured: 'This deployment cannot build a working unsubscribe link (Growth:PublicApiBaseUrl is missing or is not an https origin). Nothing was sent — a newsletter without an unsubscribe must not go out.'
translations/en.ts.growth_error_preference_centre_unconfigu: 'This deployment cannot build a preference-centre link (Growth:PreferenceCentreBaseUrl is missing or is not an https origin). Nothing was sent — recipients would have had no route to withdraw consent or ask for access.'
translations/en.ts.ev_page_intro: 'One enquiry, followed as far as this backend actually goes. Every amount is read from the server; nothing is added up here.'
translations/en.ts.ev_pipeline_unknown: 'The enquiries could not be read, so the list is not shown. That does not mean it is empty.'
translations/en.ts.ev_pipeline_disabled: 'Events is not enabled for this venue. That is a setting, and it says nothing about how many enquiries the venue has.'
translations/en.ts.ev_pipeline_forbidden: 'You are not an admin of this venue, so the list cannot be read. That says nothing about its contents.'
translations/en.ts.ev_detail_unknown: 'The details for this enquiry could not be read.'
translations/en.ts.ev_status_absent_note: 'The server reported no status for this enquiry. It is therefore placed nowhere on the rail — it is not assumed to be an enquiry.'
translations/en.ts.ev_status_offramp: 'This enquiry ended as {status} and goes no further along the rail.'
translations/en.ts.ev_field_expiry_hint: 'The offer expires at the start of that day at the venue ({zone}) — never in the browser time zone.'
translations/en.ts.ev_create_hint: 'The guest form lives on the public surface. From here an enquiry is created manually, with staff recorded as its author.'
translations/en.ts.ev_versions_none: 'No proposal version has been drafted yet.'
translations/en.ts.ev_handover_note: 'Nothing sends this link. The notification outlet is a stub on this branch, so the token has to be handed to the guest by hand.'
translations/en.ts.ev_money_rejected: 'These amounts could not be read and were not sent: {fields}. Write them as numbers with at most two decimals.'
translations/en.ts.ev_accept_note: 'The guest accepts the offer themselves, on the public link. There is no path from here between "Proposal sent" and "Accepted" — only the guest can make that move.'
translations/en.ts.ev_deposit_none: 'No deposit has been requested for this enquiry. That is the read answering, not a gap: every deposit this enquiry has ever had would be listed here, including withdrawn ones.'
translations/en.ts.ev_deposit_gated: 'The deposit surface is not enabled for this venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_deposit_no_net: 'The outstanding sum (requested minus refunded) is not worked out here. The API does not expose it, and an amount this surface invented is not an amount.'
translations/en.ts.ev_deposit_rail_note: 'A deposit can be carried end to end on: {wired}. Not wired here: {unwired} — neither creation nor completion exists for them on this branch.'
translations/en.ts.ev_refund_note: 'A partial refund is allowed. The amount is sent exactly as written; the server refuses anything above what is still unrefunded.'
translations/en.ts.ev_refund_amount_needed: 'Write the amount as a number greater than zero, with at most two decimals.'
translations/en.ts.ev_runsheet_none: 'No run sheet has been generated yet.'
translations/en.ts.ev_runsheet_gated: 'The run sheet is not enabled for this venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_runsheet_unknown: 'The run sheet could not be read.'
translations/en.ts.ev_runsheet_stale: 'This run sheet was not generated from the operative proposal version. Reissue it before service.'
translations/en.ts.ev_runsheet_print_note: 'The print carries what is recorded about allergies and diets. The guest links stay off the paper.'
translations/en.ts.ev_runsheet_print_unavailable: 'Your browser offers no print command, so the sheet was not produced.'
translations/en.ts.ev_dietary_note: 'Write what the booking contact actually said. An empty field means nobody has been asked — so if they were asked and there is nothing, write that in words.'
translations/en.ts.ev_dietary_reissue_note: 'Saving this marks the printed run sheet stale. Generate it again so the kitchen gets the requirement.'
translations/en.ts.ev_dietary_unstated: 'Nothing is recorded about allergies or diets for this booking. Nobody has answered — this is not a confirmation that there are none.'
translations/en.ts.ev_settlement_none: 'This enquiry has no settlement yet. One is created when the event is closed after service — the read answered, and the answer is that there is none.'
translations/en.ts.ev_settlement_gated: 'The settlement machine is not enabled for this venue. It is a per-venue switch (Events.Settlement) and it is off by default.'
translations/en.ts.ev_settlement_no_balance: 'The figure above is the server own line sum. A balance due is not worked out here: lines are recorded as magnitudes, and the API does not say which kinds subtract.'
translations/en.ts.ev_settlement_gate_note: 'Close, the settlement lines, reconcile and close settlement sit behind Events.Settlement — a per-venue switch that is off until someone turns it on. The buttons are here because only the server answer counts: with the switch off they answer EVENTS_DISABLED.'
translations/en.ts.ev_line_generated_note: 'Only invoice and adjustment lines are written here. Deposit and till lines are generated when the event is closed and when a till check is attached, and the server refuses them here.'
translations/en.ts.ev_line_amount_needed: 'Write the amount as a number with at most two decimals.'
translations/en.ts.ev_line_reason_needed: 'An adjustment needs a reason. It is the only thing that justifies the figure.'
translations/en.ts.ev_cancel_resolution_note: 'With no instruction the server refuses the cancellation if a deposit has been paid. That is deliberate: nothing here decides on its own whether a guest gets their money back.'
translations/en.ts.ev_refusal_state: 'That action is not permitted from this state'
translations/en.ts.ev_refusal_revision_required: 'The settlement version was missing, so nothing was written'
translations/en.ts.ev_refusal_not_reconciled: 'The settlement has to be reconciled before it can be closed'
translations/en.ts.ev_refusal_notification_sent: 'That link did reach the guest, so it will not be sent again'
translations/en.ts.ev_refusal_retry: 'We have fetched the current settlement. Press the button again to act on it.'
translations/en.ts.ev_refusal_permitted_none: 'The server named no permitted transitions from here.'
translations/en.ts.ev_notify_dispatch_on: 'Links are being sent. Waiting to go out: {queued}.'
translations/en.ts.ev_notify_dispatch_off: 'Sending is switched off, so no guest link is leaving the building. Waiting: {queued}.'
translations/en.ts.ev_notify_gated: 'Events is not enabled for this venue, so there is nothing to watch.'
translations/en.ts.ev_notify_unknown: 'The delivery read did not answer. We cannot say whether guests are being reached.'
translations/en.ts.ev_notify_none: 'No guest link has been given up on.'
translations/en.ts.ev_toast_dietary: 'The dietary requirement was recorded. Reissue the run sheet so the kitchen sees it.'
translations/en.ts.ev_toast_line_added: 'The line was added to the settlement.'
translations/en.ts.ev_toast_requeued: 'The link is queued to go out again.'
translations/en.ts.ev_toast_requeue_already_queued: 'That link was already queued — nothing changed, and it is still on its way.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_link_private: 'This link is yours. Please do not pass it on.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_footer_help: 'Any questions? Reply to the message this link came in, and the venue will take it from there.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_state_unavailable_heading: 'This page is not available right now'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_state_unavailable_body: 'We cannot fetch it at the moment. Get in touch with the venue and they will help you on.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_state_unknown_body: 'Something went wrong on the way, so we cannot say what this holds right now. Try again in a moment.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_money_no_currency: 'We are not showing the amounts here, because the currency is missing. Get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_state_not_found_body: 'The link may be incomplete. Check that you copied all of it from the message, or get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_amendment: 'This is a change to the event you have already confirmed. If you accept it, this version is the one that stands.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_stance_superseded_body: 'The venue has sent a new offer since this one, so this one can no longer be accepted. The figures below are as they stood when you got them. Use the newest link you were sent, or get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_stance_expired_body: 'This offer can no longer be accepted. Get in touch with the venue and they will gladly send a new one.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_stance_accepted_body: 'Below is the offer as it stood when it was accepted.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_stance_declined_body: 'If you have changed your mind, get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_stance_unknown_body: 'Get in touch with the venue and you can sort it out together.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_lines_none: 'This offer has no lines. Get in touch with the venue before you answer.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_minimum_spend_note: 'The minimum spend is the lowest amount the venue invoices for the event.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_money_note: 'The amounts stand on their own, as the venue entered them. We do not add them together here, and the VAT rate is shown on each line.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_terms_none: 'The venue has not attached any terms.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accept_intro: 'Write your name and email so the venue knows who answered.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accept_binding: 'By accepting, you confirm the event as it stands here.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accept_needs_name: 'Write your name, so the venue knows who answered.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accept_needs_email: 'Write an email address the venue can reach you on.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_decline_note: 'Would you like to say why? Optional.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accepted_heading: 'Thank you. The venue has your answer.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accepted_deposit: 'The venue asks for a deposit of {amount}. You will get a separate link to pay it.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_accepted_next: 'The venue will be in touch if they need anything else from you.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_declined_heading: 'Your answer is sent. You have declined.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_declined_body: 'The venue will be told. If you change your mind, get in touch with them.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_superseded: 'The venue has sent a newer offer, so this one cannot be accepted. Use the newest link you were sent.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_expired: 'The deadline has passed, so this offer cannot be accepted. Get in touch with the venue for a new one.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_not_found: 'We cannot find what this link points to. Check that you have all of it.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_unavailable: 'This is not available right now. Get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_state: 'The event has moved on since this was sent. Get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_conflict: 'Somebody answered at the same moment. Reload the page and try again.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_validation: 'Something in the form did not fit. Read the answer below and try again.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_rate_limited: 'A lot of requests have come from here. Wait a few minutes and try again.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_refused_other: 'It was refused, and we have no better explanation than the one below.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_reference_note: 'The reference tells you which edition of the offer you are reading. It is the same every time you open the link.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_not_found_body: 'The link may be incomplete. Check that you copied all of it, or get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_payable: 'The deposit has not been paid yet. You can pay it here.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_rail_unsupported: 'This payment cannot be completed on this page. Get in touch with the venue and they will find another way.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_refunded: 'The deposit has been paid back, in whole or in part. The venue can answer on the details.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_forfeited: 'The venue has kept the deposit under the cancellation terms.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_expired: 'This payment link has expired. Get in touch with the venue and they will send a new one.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_failed: 'The payment did not go through. Get in touch with the venue and they will send a new link.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_no_affordance: 'The deposit is unpaid, but this link carries no way to pay. Get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_status_unknown: 'We cannot say what is happening with this deposit. Get in touch with the venue.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_pay_note: 'You will be sent to {provider} to pay. Come back here afterwards to see the status.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_deposit_no_event: 'This page shows the deposit only. The details of the event are in the offer you were sent.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_inquiry_intro: 'Tell us briefly what you have in mind, and the venue will come back to you with an offer.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_inquiry_needs: 'We need a name, an email, a date and a number of guests before this can be sent.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_inquiry_sent_body: 'The venue will look at it and come back to you by email.'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_store_unknown_heading: 'We do not know which venue this is for'
translations/en.ts.ev_guest_store_unknown_body: 'The link is missing the venue. Use the link you got from the venue, or get in touch with them directly.'
translations/en.ts.trn_page_intro: 'One course becomes evidence: author it, publish a version, assign it, file the completion — then look up what the person actually holds.'
translations/en.ts.trn_gate_unknown: 'The context read did not answer. We do not know whether Training is on for this store, so we say nothing about it.'
translations/en.ts.trn_gate_unauthenticated: 'You are not signed in to the API.'
translations/en.ts.trn_gate_forbidden: 'The server refused. It does not distinguish a store you do not administer from a store that does not exist, so we cannot say which it was.'
translations/en.ts.trn_gate_invisible: 'Training is not switched on for this store. The module answered for itself, so it is deployed — it is simply invisible here until an operator turns training.setup on.'
translations/en.ts.trn_gate_unreachable: 'No answer from the Training module. The route is not present in this environment, so nothing can be said about this store.'
translations/en.ts.trn_footnote_zone: 'Timestamps are shown in the store timezone ({zone}) as the server resolved it. Dates (issued, expires, due) are shown as the day that was filed, unconverted.'
translations/en.ts.trn_footnote_zone_fallback: 'The store carries no valid timezone. The server fell back to {zone} and the timestamps below are shown in it. Dates are shown as the day that was filed, unconverted.'
translations/en.ts.trn_footnote_zone_utc: 'The store timezone is unknown, so timestamps are shown in UTC. Dates are shown as the day that was filed, unconverted.'
translations/en.ts.trn_footnote_scope: 'This page is the record of courses, assignments, completions and certificates. Editing drafts, retiring versions, correcting certificates and the expiry feed are not wired up here.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_validation: 'The server refused the contents of the request.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_forbidden: 'The server refused. It does not distinguish missing access from a store that does not exist.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_not_found: 'The server did not find the resource. The answer is the same whether it is absent, belongs to another store, or the module is off — so we do not know which.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_idem_mismatch: 'The same idempotency key was used with different contents. Nothing was written.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_idem_inflight: 'An identical request is already in flight. Reload and try again.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_immutable: 'The version is not a draft. A published version\'s content is frozen — a change is a new version.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_flag_off: 'This area is switched off for the store. Reads still answer; writes do not.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_unknown: 'Something went wrong, and the failure did not come from the Training module.'
translations/en.ts.trn_err_person_unknown: 'The id does not identify a known person, so nothing was filed. Check it against the staff list, or against the person id Workforce shows.'
translations/en.ts.trn_flags_note: 'These are the server\'s answers, not a guess. With a flag off, reads still answer — writes are refused.'
translations/en.ts.trn_writes_blocked_setup: 'The server reports that courses and certificates are switched off for this store. Writes will be refused.'
translations/en.ts.trn_writes_blocked_assignments: 'The server reports that assignment and completion are switched off for this store. Writes will be refused.'
translations/en.ts.trn_reference_by_value: 'The reference is a Workforce person or role id, carried as a value. Nothing checks it on an assignment: an id naming nobody is accepted exactly as one that names somebody.'
translations/en.ts.trn_reference_malformed: 'That is not an id. A reference is a 36-character identifier of the form 0f9c1a5e-4b2d-4c7a-9e10-3d5f8b6a1c24. The server cannot read anything else, and its refusal would not say why.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_people_unknown: 'The staff list did not answer, so there are no names to pick from. Type the person id instead.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_people_refused: 'You cannot read this store\'s staff list, so there are no names to pick from — it needs a workforce capability that administering the store does not confer. Type the person id instead.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_people_empty: 'Nobody is engaged at this store, so there is nothing to pick from. Type the person id instead: evidence can be filed for a person this store has never engaged.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_people_pick: 'Pick somebody from the list, or type the person id.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_people_no_match: 'That id is not on this store\'s staff list. It may still be accepted — the server checks that the person exists at all, not that they work here.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_roles_unknown: 'The role list did not answer, so there are no names to pick from. Type the role id instead.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_roles_refused: 'You cannot read this store\'s role list, so there are no names to pick from — it needs a workforce capability that administering the store does not confer. Type the role id instead.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_roles_empty: 'This store has no roles, so there is nothing to pick from. Type the role id instead.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_roles_pick: 'Pick a role from the list, or type the role id.'
translations/en.ts.trn_directory_roles_no_match: 'That id is not one of this store\'s roles. It will be accepted anyway — nothing checks a role reference.'
translations/en.ts.trn_courses_unknown: 'The course list did not answer. We do not know which courses this store has.'
translations/en.ts.trn_courses_refused: 'The server refused the course list without saying why. That does not mean the store has no courses.'
translations/en.ts.trn_course_no_competency: 'This course confers no competency key — it is training only.'
translations/en.ts.trn_course_competency_hint: 'The key is what a passing completion confers on the person. Leave it empty for a course that confers none.'
translations/en.ts.trn_versions_pick_course: 'Select a course in the list to see its versions.'
translations/en.ts.trn_versions_unknown: 'The course did not answer. We do not know which versions it has.'
translations/en.ts.trn_versions_refused: 'The server refused the course read without saying why.'
translations/en.ts.trn_version_publish_note: 'Publishing freezes the content and mints the hash. Every completion filed afterwards is stamped with it, and that stamp is what later shows which material the person actually passed.'
translations/en.ts.trn_version_quiz_absent: 'No quiz is authored here. Nobody could take one: the worker app where a quiz would be sat does not exist in this version. And quiz content is part of the hash that publishing freezes for good, so a shape guessed now would be locked into every completion filed against this version. Versions created here carry no quiz.'
translations/en.ts.trn_assign_refused: 'The server refused the assignment list without saying why.'
translations/en.ts.trn_assign_no_published: 'No published version to assign. Publish one first — the server refuses to assign a draft or a retired version.'
translations/en.ts.trn_completions_refused: 'The server refused the completion list without saying why.'
translations/en.ts.trn_result_unknown: 'The server did not say whether this completion passed.'
translations/en.ts.trn_source_quiz_note: 'Filed as a quiz attempt. Nothing in this version can produce one, so this row was written by something outside it.'
translations/en.ts.trn_completion_no_frozen: 'No frozen version to file against. A completion must be stamped against a published or retired version.'
translations/en.ts.trn_completion_person_known: 'The person must already exist in Workforce — the server refuses an id it does not recognise and files nothing. It checks that the person exists, in any state, not that they work at this store.'
translations/en.ts.trn_completion_grading_note: 'The server decides pass or fail. It compares the score entered here against the pass threshold of the version filed against — exactly at the threshold passes, and nothing is rounded first. There is no pass box because the record cannot be changed afterwards, and a pass the score does not support could never be corrected.'
translations/en.ts.trn_certs_refused: 'The server refused the certificate list without saying why.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_intro: 'Every read of a person\'s training record is written to the same unchangeable ledger the edits are. This is that ledger, for one person in this store.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_intro_own: 'Every read of your training record is written to a ledger that cannot be edited afterwards. This is that ledger, for this workplace.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_prompt: 'Look up a person id to see who has seen their record.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_refused: 'The server refused the lookup. That means you are neither the person this is about nor an admin of this store — it does not mean the log is empty.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_empty: 'Nobody has looked at this training record in this store.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_no_names: 'The log does not name anybody. The server stores a user reference rather than a name, and resolving it would be a disclosure about the person who looked — that decision has not been made here. You are shown when, how many different people, and whether one of them was you.'
translations/en.ts.trn_disclosure_recorded: 'Opening this log is itself a read, and is written to it. That is why it does not load on its own.'
translations/en.ts.trn_certs_status_asof: 'Status was computed by the server at {asOf}, not by the browser.'
translations/en.ts.trn_certs_status_asof_unknown: 'Status was computed by the server. The moment it was computed did not come back with the answer.'
translations/en.ts.trn_cert_person_known: 'The person must already exist in Workforce — the server refuses an id it does not recognise and registers nothing. It checks that the person exists, including one who has only been invited, not that they work at this store.'
translations/en.ts.trn_cert_type_hint: 'The type doubles as the competency key the certificate confers.'
translations/en.ts.trn_cert_expiry_hint: 'An empty expiry means a certificate with no expiry, which the server treats as permanently valid.'
translations/en.ts.trn_cert_expiry_before_issue: 'The expiry is before the issue date. The server refuses that, so it is not sent.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_intro: 'This is the proof that the five steps above did anything: the lookup shows competency keys from passing completions, and valid certificates, for one person.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_prompt: 'Look up a person id to see what has been filed.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_refused: 'The server refused the lookup without saying why.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_no_keys: 'No competency key is on record for this person.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_no_certs: 'No valid certificate is on record for this person.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_not_a_verdict: 'This is what is on record, not a judgement. Training never says whether somebody is qualified — an absent entry means nothing was filed, not that a requirement is unmet. Expired certificates are left out of this list; they are in the certificate list.'
translations/en.ts.trn_holdings_asof_unknown: 'The moment the server computed this did not come back with the answer.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_page_intro: 'What an hour costs, what was actually worked, and the file that carries the hours out to payroll.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_context_failed: 'We could not read this store\'s timezone and capabilities. The page shows nothing rather than guess.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_no_capability: 'You do not have access to the workforce module in this store.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_no_capability: 'You do not have access to pay rates in this store.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_no_capability_note: 'Rates require the WorkforcePayrollApprover capability on top of WorkforceManager — to read them as much as to set them. The server does not disclose which of the two is missing.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_append_only: 'A rate is never edited. It applies from a date, and every earlier rate stays standing — anything already costed keeps costing the same. A wrong rate is corrected by stating a new one from a LATER date.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_unknown: 'We could not read the rates. That does not mean there are none.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_none_yet: 'No rate has been stated for this yet.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_conflict_named: 'The rate that already applies from that date is marked in the table above.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_wire_preview: 'Sent as {minor} minor units per worked hour ({currency}).'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_amount_nan: 'The hourly rate must be a plain number, for example 235.50.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_amount_decimals: 'At most two decimal places — the minor unit is the smallest amount stored.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_amount_not_positive: 'An hourly rate must be greater than zero. "Unpaid" is a pay-code question, never a rate.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_amount_too_large: 'That amount is too large to store exactly.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_currency_invalid: 'Currency is a three-letter ISO 4217 code, for example NOK.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_collision: 'A rate already applies from {date}. Rates cannot be edited — pick a later date to state a new one.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_supersedes: 'The rate from {date} will be closed on the new date. What it paid until then does not change.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_bounded_by: 'A rate already applies from {date}. The new rate applies only up to then — it does not cancel the later one.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_read_only: 'You can see the rates here, but not state new ones.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_rate_conflict_toast: 'A rate already applies from that date. State a new one from a later date.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_scope_prompt: 'Choose a person or a role to see and state rates.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_scope_unknown: 'We could not read the list. It is not empty — we simply do not know what is in it.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_scope_no_staff: 'No staff are engaged at this store.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_scope_no_roles: 'No roles have been created at this store.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_att_published_only: 'Planned hours count PUBLISHED shifts only. A week still in draft contributes no planned time, so anything clocked against it reads as unplanned.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_att_unknown: 'We could not read the hours. That does not mean nobody worked.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_att_empty: 'No published shifts and no clocked sessions in this period.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_att_no_correction_ui: 'Corrections cannot be made from here: the endpoint names a clock session, and no read a manager can reach returns a session id. The counts above come from the attendance read itself.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_att_no_capability: 'You do not have access to the hours view in this store. It requires the WorkforceManager capability.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_intro: 'Hours per person, per business day, per pay code. The dates are the venue\'s own calendar dates, and both ends are included.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_no_capability: 'The hours export requires the WorkforcePayrollApprover capability.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_range_reversed: 'The end date cannot precede the start date.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_range_too_long: 'The period can be at most {max} days.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_unknown_version: 'The file is marked version {version}, which this page does not know. Its contents are not interpreted.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_incomplete: 'The file is not complete: {count} rows carry no hours figure.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_completeness_unstated: 'The file does not say whether it is complete.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_hours_only: 'The file carries hours only — no rate, no wage, no employer cost.'
translations/en.ts.wfrt_exp_download_unavailable: 'This browser cannot download the file here.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_page_intro: 'Who is at the workplace now, and who was earlier the same day — with the time work began and the time it ended. The list must be available at the workplace and printable on paper immediately.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_context_failed: 'We could not read this store\'s timezone and capabilities. The page shows nothing rather than guess.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_no_capability: 'You do not hold the WorkforceManager grant in this store. The personnel list is read with that grant only — neither store administration nor Power User admits you on its own.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_print_unavailable: 'This browser offers no print command here. Use the browser\'s own print (Ctrl/Cmd + P).'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_date_invalid: 'The date must be a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_identity_gap: 'IDENTIFICATION: § 8-5-6 requires each person\'s name and fødselsnummer (Norwegian national identity number) or D-number. Those numbers may be replaced by unique codes, but only if an overview of the codes used, with the corresponding national identity number or D-number, is kept. Okam neither collects nor stores national identity numbers, and keeps no such code overview. The codes below therefore cannot be resolved to a national identity number here. The list covers names, times and business identity, but not the identification requirement on its own — the business must keep the code overview itself, or the list must be supplemented with the national identity numbers.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_business_mixed: 'This day\'s entries were recorded under {count} different accounting entities. The "Workplace" field is therefore left empty: the list cannot answer with one name and one organisation number when the rows belong to several.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_zone_fallback: 'This store carries no valid time zone. The times below are shown in {zone} because that is the platform default — not because anyone chose it for this workplace.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_zone_unusable: 'The time zone "{zone}" cannot be read by this browser, so the times cannot be placed in the workplace\'s own clock. The list is withheld rather than shown against the wrong clock.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_unknown: 'We could not read the personnel list. That does not mean nobody was at work — we simply do not know what it says.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_empty: 'Nobody is recorded on the personnel list for this day.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_summary_today: '{count} entries this day. {open} are at the workplace now.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_summary_past: '{count} entries this day. {open} of them have no end time recorded.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_retain_until: 'The personnel list must be kept in Norway until {date} — three years and six months after the end of the accounting year.'
translations/en.ts.wfpl_corrections: '{count} of the entries have been corrected. Who corrected them and when is in the note column.'
translations/en.ts.sm_no_store: 'Select a store to see its market.'
translations/en.ts.sm_read_failed: 'We could not read this store\'s market. That does not mean the store has no market — we simply do not know what it says.'
translations/en.ts.sm_currency_is_derived: 'The currency follows from the country and is not set here.'
translations/en.ts.sm_no_country_warning: 'This store has no country. The country selects the working-time rule pack, so without one the schedule refuses every week you try to publish.'
translations/en.ts.sm_no_rulepack_warning: 'This store is in {country}, and there is no working-time rule pack for that country. The schedule will refuse every week you try to publish.'
translations/en.ts.sm_zone_fallback_warning: 'No time zone has been chosen for this venue. Its business days are currently cut at {zone} because that is the platform default — not because anyone decided it for this store. If the venue is somewhere else, its days are being split at the wrong moment.'
translations/en.ts.sm_country_help: 'The list is the markets that have a working-time rule pack. Today that is Norway only. Another country can technically be stored, but the schedule would then refuse every week — so it is not offered here.'
translations/en.ts.sm_country_not_offered: '{country} (the country this store is in now)'
translations/en.ts.sm_choice_no_rulepack_warning: 'There is no working-time rule pack for {country}. Saving this will set the market, but the schedule will refuse every week you try to publish.'
translations/en.ts.sm_currency_consequence_unknown: 'The platform decides the currency from the country when you save.'
translations/en.ts.sm_zone_help: 'A time-zone id the platform can load, for example Europe/Oslo. The country does not determine it — several countries span several zones, so it has to be chosen.'
translations/en.ts.sm_zone_help_current_default: 'Choose none and the days keep being cut at {zone}.'
translations/en.ts.sm_unchanged_note: 'Nothing has changed. The values above are the store\'s market as it still stands.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_country_missing: 'No country was chosen. A market is set with a two-letter code such as NO.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_country_invalid: '‘{country}’ is not a country code the platform knows. A market is set with a two-letter code such as NO.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_currency_underivable: 'The platform cannot determine a currency for {country}, so money in a store there could not be labelled. The market is refused rather than stored half-configured.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_currency_not_authoritative: 'This page expected {country} to mean {expected}. The platform disagrees, and the platform decides: the currency follows from the market and is never taken from the form. It is the market configuration that needs correcting, not anything you typed.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_timezone_missing: 'A time zone is required. The country does not determine one, and choosing one for you would put this venue\'s business days on a clock nobody decided.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_timezone_unresolvable: 'The time zone ‘{zone}’ cannot be loaded on this platform. Use an IANA id such as Europe/Oslo.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_timezone_change_unsafe: 'This store already has schedule, attendance or journal history that was computed and stored against the clock in {current}. Those dates are never re-derived, so moving the store to {requested} would leave old and new rows meaning different days. This is not something you typed wrong: re-zoning an operating store needs a data migration, and it cannot be done from here.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_currency_change_unsafe: 'This store already has money recorded while it was labelled {stored}. Amounts are stored in minor units and are never converted, so labelling them in another currency would misstate figures that already exist. This is not something you typed wrong: moving an operating store between currencies needs a data migration, and it cannot be done from here.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_store_not_found: 'The platform does not know this store.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_denied: 'You are not allowed to change this store\'s market. It requires store admin.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_unauthenticated: 'The session has expired. Log in again and retry.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_untyped: 'The platform refused the change for a reason this page has no wording of its own for. The platform\'s own answer is below.'
translations/en.ts.sm_refuse_transport: 'We got no answer from the platform, so nothing was decided about the market. Try again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_private_note: 'This code is yours. Please do not pass it on — it works once, and only for you.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_footer_help: 'Anything unclear? Reply to the message the code came in, and your employer will take it from there.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_paste_intro: 'Your employer has set up a meal scheme with Okam and created a single-use code for you. Paste it in here.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_paste_empty: 'We need the code to go further. Paste it into the field above.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_paste_help: 'Okam does not send these codes out, by email or by text. Yours came from your employer. If you do not have one, they are the people to ask.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_signin_body: 'The invitation was made out to one particular person, and we cannot look it up until you are signed in. You sign in with your phone number and a code by text.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_signin_kept: 'The code you pasted stays here while you sign in. You will not have to find it again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_preview_title_unnamed: 'You have been invited to a company scheme'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_unknowns_body: 'The invitation names the company you are joining and the role you get — and nothing else. How much you have to spend, which places the scheme covers, and who invited you are not in it, so we cannot show you those here. Ask your employer if you want to know before you accept.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_effect: 'Press this and you become a member of your company\'s meal scheme. The code is used up and cannot be used again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_done_body: 'Your membership is active from now, with the role {role}.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_done_next: 'Your employer can tell you where the scheme applies and how much you have to spend. Okam has no such overview to show you here yet.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_ref_body: 'The bills your company gets from Okam identify you by this reference rather than by your name. Keep it: if you ever need to ask about a line on one of them, this is what you will have to quote.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_unknown_body: 'Part of the code may be missing, it may already be used up, or the scheme may not be switched on at our end. We are not told which of those it is. Check that you got the whole code, and ask whoever gave it to you if it still does not work.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_used_body: 'Somebody has already accepted this invitation. If that was you, you are in already and there is nothing more to do. If it was not, tell your employer — they can create a new code.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_withdrawn_body: 'Your employer has withdrawn this invitation. If you are still meant to join, ask them for a new code.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_expired_body: 'Invitations only last a while. Ask your employer for a new code — it takes them a moment.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_closed_title: 'This invitation can no longer be used'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_closed_body: 'We were not told why. Ask your employer for a new code.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_wrong_account_title: 'This invitation belongs to a different account'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_wrong_account_body: 'The code is fine, but it was made out to one particular email address or phone number, and the account you are signed in with is not it. We do not say which one — a stray code would then tell anybody holding it which account they needed. Try signing in with the account your employer has on file for you, or ask them which one they used.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_already_member_body: 'The account you are signed in with is already a member of this company\'s meal scheme. There is nothing more to do.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_signed_out_body: 'Your session ran out. Sign in again — the code stays here for as long as you keep this page open.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_no_code_body: 'The request went without the code. Press "Try a different code" and paste it in again.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_in_progress_body: 'Your previous attempt has not finished. Wait a few seconds and try again — it will not make you a member twice.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_collision_body: 'The attempt collided with another one from this page. Try once more and we will send a completely fresh request.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_no_module_title: 'We could not reach the meal scheme'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_no_module_body: 'The server answered, but not as the meal scheme, so we know nothing about your invitation. Nothing has changed. Try again shortly, and tell whoever gave you the code if it keeps happening.'
translations/en.ts.meals_claim_offline_body: 'Something went wrong on the way and we cannot tell whether the request arrived. Check that you are online and try again: it will not make you a member twice, and the code is not lost by an attempt that never landed.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_state_unknown_body: 'We got no answer. There is nothing wrong with your link — try again in a moment.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_refused_consent_text_unknown: 'The consent wording on this page is no longer current. Reload the page and we will fetch the wording that applies now.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_refused_token_invalid: 'The link has been used or has expired.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_refused_scope_mismatch: 'This link does not cover what you tried to change.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_standing_suppressed: 'Blocked — we do not send to you'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_request_deadline: 'The venue has one month to answer you. That follows from GDPR article 12.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_intro: 'Signing up takes two steps. You enter your email address here, and it only becomes active once it has been confirmed from your inbox. Until then you are not on the list and you get nothing from us.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_which_venue: 'The consent covers only the venue you came here from. If you have signed up at several places, each one stands on its own.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_consent_recorded: 'Wording version {version} ({locale}). This exact sentence is what gets stored with your consent — not a summary of it.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_consent_language: 'The consent wording is in Norwegian ({locale}) because that is the wording that gets stored. We do not translate it here: you would then be reading something other than what your receipt actually says.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_needs_email: 'Enter an email address we can use.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_needs_consent: 'Tick the consent box first. Without it we are not allowed to register you.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_leaving_is_easy: 'You can leave at any time, and it should be no harder than joining. Every email has a link straight to your settings at the bottom.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_accepted_body: 'The signup is not active yet. It becomes active once it is confirmed from the inbox of the address you gave.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_accepted_nothing_yet: 'Until then nothing is recorded as a consent, and nothing is sent to you.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_accepted_no_oracle: 'We do not say whether the address is already on file with us. The answer here is the same either way — that is how we stop this page being used to work out who is on the list.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_accepted_nothing_arrives: 'If no confirmation arrives, you are not on the list and there is nothing you need to do. If you want to be on it anyway, take it up with the venue directly.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_signup_unavailable_body: 'This venue does not take signups on this page. Either they have not switched the newsletter on, or the link points somewhere we cannot find — and we deliberately do not distinguish between the two.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_done_body: 'You are now on the newsletter list of the venue you signed up with. It covers that one venue only.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_done_leaving: 'At the bottom of every email there is a link to your settings. There you can see what we hold, stop the emails, or ask to be erased.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_done_replay: 'Open this link again and you will see the same thing. You are not signed up twice.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_dead_body: 'We do not say which of these it is, and that is deliberate — a page that answered differently could be used to work out who is on the list:'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_dead_used: 'it has already been used, in which case you are probably on the list already'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_dead_superseded: 'you signed up again afterwards, which made the earlier link invalid'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_dead_next: 'If you are unsure, sign up again. No harm is done if you are already there.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_notoken_body: 'This page needs the whole link to do anything. The part after the # is missing.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_notoken_why: 'That part is often dropped when a link is copied or forwarded. Open it again from the message it came in rather than pasting it.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_confirm_unknown_body: 'We got no answer, so we do not know whether the confirmation went through. Try again.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_intro: 'This is what is on record about you, and this is where you change it.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_no_address: 'We do not show your email address on this page. Anyone holding the link can open it, so the page knows only that the link belongs to you — not which address it went to.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_one_venue: 'This page covers one venue. If you have signed up at several, each has its own link at the bottom of its own emails.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_control_on: 'You receive the newsletter from this venue.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_control_off: 'You receive no newsletter from this venue.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_resume_blocked: 'We could not start them again from here. Your address is blocked, and a block is only lifted by signing up again and confirming from your inbox. Someone ticking a box on a form is not proof enough that you are the one who owns the address — so this stays as it is.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_stopped_note: 'That is recorded. No further newsletters will be sent to you from this venue.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_session_note: 'The link here can be used once, and the page stays open for 30 minutes at a time. If it takes longer, use the link in the most recent email you have.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_dead_body: 'We do not say which of these it is, deliberately:'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_dead_used: 'it has already been used — each link opens the page once'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_dead_next: 'Use the link at the bottom of the most recent email you have from the venue. If you only want the emails to stop, you can also reply to the message and ask them.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_session_dead_body: 'A session lasts 30 minutes and yours is over. What you managed to change is saved; the rest stands as before.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_session_dead_next: 'The link you arrived with cannot be used again. Use the link in your most recent email to open the page afresh.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_notoken_body: 'This page needs the whole link to know whose settings to show. The part after the # is missing.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_prefs_unknown_body: 'We could not reach the server. Try the link again in a moment.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_access_body: 'You can ask for a copy of what is stored about you here: consents, blocks, and which mailings have been sent to you. That is the right of access in GDPR article 15.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_access_filed_body: 'The venue is to give you a machine-readable copy of what they hold about you in this context. A person there does that, and it does not happen at this moment.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_body: 'You can ask for your email address to be erased. That is the right to erasure in GDPR article 17. It cannot be undone, so read what happens before you do it.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_irreversible: 'This cannot be undone. Three things happen, at three different times:'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_step_now: 'Immediately: you are blocked from all marketing email from us. That happens the moment you send the request, not when it has been dealt with.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_step_later: 'Afterwards: the venue carries out the erasure itself. Your email address is then made unreadable — the key is destroyed and the address cannot be recovered. A person does that work, and it does not happen at this moment.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_step_kept: 'This remains: that you once consented, and that you asked to be erased. That log can be neither changed nor deleted — it is the evidence that we were allowed to email you, and that you asked us to stop. After the erasure it holds no readable address.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_step_shared: 'If you share an email address with another venue that still holds a valid consent, the erasure itself is deferred until that consent is gone too. The block applies from now regardless.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_filed_now: 'The block applies from now. No further marketing email will be sent to you.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_erasure_filed_later: 'The erasure itself has not been carried out yet. The venue does that, and only then is the address made unreadable.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_done_body: 'No further newsletters will be sent to you from this venue.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_done_scope: 'This covers this one venue. If you have signed up at several, each has to be left separately.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_done_return: 'If you change your mind you can sign up again. That needs a fresh confirmation from your inbox — we cannot put you back on the list without one.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_done_replay: 'We did not ask you to confirm first. Leaving should be as easy as joining.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_dead_body: 'Unsubscribe links last two years. This one is either older than that, or it is not an unsubscribe link.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_dead_next: 'Use the link at the bottom of the most recent email you have. There you can also stop the mailings and ask to be erased.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_notoken_body: 'This page needs the whole link to know who to unsubscribe.'
translations/en.ts.gr_guest_unsub_unknown_body: 'We got no answer, so you are probably NOT unsubscribed. Try again.'
translations/en.ts.ff_page_intro: 'The switches that decide what the six modules may write for this store. Everything is off to begin with: a switch that is not on refuses writes — reads and exports of what is already recorded keep working.'
translations/en.ts.ff_effective_note: '"Effective" is the answer the module\'s own gate gives. Some modules also sit under a deployment switch in the server configuration that this page cannot see. So "effective: off" can be relied on, while "effective: on" is not a promise that the write will go through.'
translations/en.ts.ff_withheld_note: 'The list is the catalogue the service reports. A module may have stages deliberately not offered here — they would have no effect whatever they were set to, and a switch that does nothing is worse than no switch.'
translations/en.ts.ff_catalog_unknown: 'We could not read the catalogue, so we do not know for certain which keys the service accepts. The switches below may therefore be refused.'
translations/en.ts.ff_read_failed: 'We could not read this store\'s switches. Nothing below is known — it does not mean everything is off.'
translations/en.ts.ff_forbidden: 'You are not a store admin for this store. The service does not say whether the store exists.'
translations/en.ts.ff_overruled: 'The switch is on, but the module\'s gate still answers off. Something else is holding the module down — a master flag or a deployment switch in the server configuration. Turning this off and on again changes nothing.'
translations/en.ts.ff_state_unknown_row: 'This key is in the catalogue, but the store\'s answer did not carry it. We do not know what it is set to here.'
translations/en.ts.ff_not_writable: 'The catalogue does not carry this key, so the service refuses to write it. No switch is offered.'
translations/en.ts.ff_precondition_events_deposits: 'Before this is switched on: the store must already have taken live orders through its own payment setup. Deposits are charged through exactly that merchant configuration and set nothing up of their own. Nothing here checks it — switching this on for a store that has never taken a live payment will succeed, and it is a failure of procedure, not of the software.'
translations/en.ts.ff_cleared: 'The override on {flag} is removed. The module default applies again.'
translations/en.ts.gp_page_intro: 'Guests who have asked this store for access to their data or for its erasure. The guest was told on screen that you answer within one month, so a request left sitting here is a promise going unkept.'
translations/en.ts.gp_deadline_note: 'The deadline below is one calendar month from the time the request was received. That follows from GDPR article 12(3) — the same deadline the guest was shown.'
translations/en.ts.gp_masked_note: 'The service never gives this page the guest\'s address, only an internal contact-point number. To recognise a guest, ask them for the reference they were given.'
translations/en.ts.gp_forbidden: 'You are not a store administrator for this store. The service does not say whether the store exists.'
translations/en.ts.gp_read_failed: 'We could not read this store\'s requests. That does not mean nobody has asked — we do not know.'
translations/en.ts.gp_overdue_banner_one: 'The deadline has passed on one request.'
translations/en.ts.gp_due_unknown: 'The service sent no deadline for this request, so none is shown. This page does not work one out — an invented date could differ from the one the guest was promised. Reload, and until it comes back treat the request as pressing.'
translations/en.ts.gp_notice_submittedtotransport: 'The mail provider accepted the notice to the guest. Whether it arrived we do not know — only the provider can say.'
translations/en.ts.gp_notice_notattempted: 'No notice was sent. The address had already been destroyed, so there was nobody to send to.'
translations/en.ts.gp_notice_attemptedandfailed: 'A notice was attempted and refused. Nothing was destroyed, and the request is still open.'
translations/en.ts.gp_notice_none: 'No notice receipt is recorded on this request.'
translations/en.ts.gp_fulfil_erasure_warning: 'This cannot be undone. The guest is first told the erasure is done, and then the address is destroyed — or marked for destruction if another store still holds valid consent for the same contact point. This list does not say which of the two happened.'
translations/en.ts.gp_fulfil_access_warning: 'The service builds the guest\'s own history and mails it to the guest\'s address. None of it is shown on this screen, and the export is not stored.'
translations/en.ts.gp_reason_placeholder: 'Why is this refused? Do not write personal data here.'
translations/en.ts.gp_reason_required: 'A refusal needs a reason. It stays recorded on the request.'
translations/en.ts.gp_toast_rejected: 'Request {reference} was refused, and the reason is recorded.'
translations/en.ts.gp_error_not_found: 'That request is not here. The service answers the same way for a request that does not exist and one belonging to another store.'
translations/en.ts.gp_error_reason_required: 'A refusal needs a reason. Nothing was saved.'
translations/en.ts.gp_error_invalid_resolution: 'The outcome has to be either carried out or refused. Nothing was saved.'
translations/en.ts.gp_error_unattributed: 'We could not establish who you are. An erasure is never recorded without naming who ordered it, so nothing was done.'
translations/en.ts.gp_error_notice_undeliverable: 'The mail provider would not accept the notice the guest is owed. Nothing was destroyed, the request is still open, and you can try again.'
translations/en.ts.gp_error_body_required: 'The request carried no content. Nothing was saved.'
translations/en.ts.ae_page_intro: 'The address on your own account, and its confirmation. It is used wherever the platform has to know an address really is yours — for instance before you can send yourself a test of a newsletter.'
translations/en.ts.ae_status_confirmed_body: 'The address is confirmed. You can send yourself a test of a newsletter.'
translations/en.ts.ae_status_unconfirmed_body: 'The account has an address, but it is not confirmed. Until it is, the platform does not treat it as yours.'
translations/en.ts.ae_status_missing_body: 'The account has no email address. That is the usual case when you signed up with a phone number.'
translations/en.ts.ae_address_invalid: 'That does not look like an email address. Nothing was sent.'
translations/en.ts.ae_code_requested: 'The code has been ordered. We do not get to know whether the mail arrived, so if nothing turns up within a couple of minutes, send a new one.'
